wikitimemachine-desc: Compare a Wikipedia article as it stood on two dates and ask what changed, with permanent revision citations.
wikitimemachine-intro: Pick an article and two moments in time (UTC). You will see the article text as it stood at each moment, what changed between them, and can ask a question answered only from those two revisions.
wikitimemachine-question-placeholder: e.g. How did the article describe the status of Olkiluoto 3?
wikitimemachine-reversed: The first date must not be after the second date.
wikitimemachine-open-revision: Open this exact revision on Wikipedia
wikitimemachine-status-not_covered: No covered snapshot for this time.
wikitimemachine-status-no_revision: The article did not exist yet at this time.
wikitimemachine-status-unavailable: The text of this revision is hidden or unavailable.
wikitimemachine-status-unknown_page: This article has not been ingested.
wikitimemachine-no-change: No differences in the extracted text.
wikitimemachine-same-revision: Both dates resolve to the same revision.
wikitimemachine-gen-disabled: Answer generation is not configured. Showing the retrieved evidence from each revision.
wikitimemachine-gen-unavailable: The answer model is unavailable right now. Showing the retrieved evidence from each revision.
wikitimemachine-gen-rejected: The model's answer failed citation checks and was discarded. Showing the retrieved evidence from each revision.
wikitimemachine-no-support: No supporting passage found in the retrieved evidence.
wikitimemachine-date-only-note: A date without a time means the end of that day (23:59:59 UTC).
wikitimemachine-extracted-note: Extracted text: templates, tables, images and references are omitted. Use the revision links for the complete original.
